title: Users
heading: Workspace users
description: Manage sign-in accounts and access status. Only administrators can manage users.
passwordNote: The initial and reset password is <0>password</0>. Disabling, deleting or resetting a user immediately invalidates their existing sessions.
searchLabel: Search by username or display name

fields.usernameHint: 3–32 letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens.
fields.adminUsernameHint: The system administrator's username cannot be changed.
fields.displayNamePlaceholder: Optional name to identify this user
fields.enabled: Allow this user to sign in
fields.disableWarning: Saving will end this user's existing sessions.

confirmations.delete: Delete this sign-in account? This cannot be undone and the user will be signed out immediately.
confirmations.reset: The password will be reset to <0>password</0> and the user must sign in again. Resetting your own administrator account will also sign you out.
confirmations.disable: Disabling this user prevents sign-in and immediately invalidates existing sessions.
confirmations.enable: Once enabled, this user can sign in with their existing password.

notices.created: User created. The initial password is password.
notices.deleted: User deleted. Their sessions have been invalidated.
notices.reset: Password reset to password. The user must sign in again.
notices.disabled: User disabled. Their sessions have been invalidated.
notices.enabled: User enabled. They can sign in again.

adminOnly: This page is only available to administrators.
